info.title: CIDR Calculator API
info.description:
API documentation for subnet calculation, IP range check, and CIDR aggregation.

### Authorization

Every method requires an API key in the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer ak_your_key
```

Keys are created in your account, section [API keys](https://atlorium.com/Account/Manage/ApiKeys).
The API has no guest access: a request without a key returns 401.

### Sandbox

The key `ak_sandbox_demo_mockdata_v1` works without registration and is never charged — it
returns realistic demo data and marks the response with the `X-Atlorium-Sandbox: true` header.
Use it to validate your response parsing before plugging in a real key.

### Billing

Credits are charged **only for a successful response**. Rejections (400, 401, 402, 429, 5xx)
are never charged. Prices and free quotas are on the [pricing page](https://atlorium.com/pricing);
the balance is topped up in your [account](https://atlorium.com/Account/Manage/Billing).

### Errors

Every rejection returns **the same JSON structure** — see the `ApiError` schema at the bottom
of this page. There is no need to parse a different shape per status code: the machine-readable
reason always lives in the `error` field.

### Useful links

* [Service overview](https://atlorium.com/cidrDescription) — what it does, where the data comes from, what it does not cover
* [Web interface](https://atlorium.com/cidrGUI) — the same lookups by hand, no key required
* [Pricing and limits](https://atlorium.com/pricing)
* [Account: API keys](https://atlorium.com/Account/Manage/ApiKeys)
* [Account: balance and payments](https://atlorium.com/Account/Manage/Billing)
* [Blog](https://atlorium.com/blog)
* [Report a problem](https://atlorium.com/bug-report) · [support@atlorium.com](mailto:support@atlorium.com)
* [Terms of Service](https://atlorium.com/terms-of-service) · [Privacy policy](https://atlorium.com/privacy-policy)

get.summary: Calculates all parameters of a CIDR block.
get.description:
Example request: GET /api/cidr/calculate?ip=192.168.1.0&mask=24

Returns:
- Network Address
- Broadcast Address
- Netmask
- Wildcard Mask
- First/Last Usable IP
- Total/Usable Hosts
- Binary/Hex representations

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6), e.g.: 192.168.1.0 or 2001:db8::1

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Subnet mask in CIDR notation (0–32 for IPv4, 0–128 for IPv6)

200.description: Successful response. Returns a CidrCalculationResult object with all network parameters.

400.description:
Invalid request parameters:
- IP address is not specified or has an invalid format
- Mask is out of the valid range

get.summary: Splits a CIDR block into subnets with the specified new mask.
get.description:
Example request: GET /api/cidr/subnets?cidr=192.168.0.0/16&newMask=24

If the number of subnets exceeds 128, only the first 128 are returned.
The IsTruncated flag indicates that the result has been truncated.

parameters.name: newMask
parameters.description: New mask for subnets (must be greater than the current one)

200.description: Successful response. Returns a SubnetBreakdownResult object with the list of subnets.

400.description:
Invalid request parameters:
- CIDR is not specified or has an invalid format
- New mask is less than or equal to the current one

post.summary: Calculates the smallest common CIDR (Supernet) covering all input IP/CIDR entries.
post.description:
Example request: POST /api/cidr/supernet
Body: { "inputs": ["192.168.1.0/24", "192.168.2.0/24", "192.168.3.0/24"] }

Supported input formats:
- CIDR: 192.168.0.0/24
- Single IP: 192.168.1.1

Mixing IPv4 and IPv6 is not supported.

requestBody.description: List of IP addresses and/or CIDRs for aggregation

200.description: Successful response. Returns a SupernetResult object with the aggregated CIDR.

400.description:
Invalid request parameters:
- IP/CIDR list is not specified or empty
- Mixing IPv4 and IPv6
- Invalid format of one of the input values

ApiError.title: API error

error.description:
Machine-readable reason code. Possible values:

* `server_error` (500) — Сервис временно недоступен
* `unauthorized` (401) — Требуется вход
* `api_key_required` (401) — Нужен API-ключ
* `account_not_activated` (402) — Аккаунт не активирован
* `rate_limited_client` (429) — Слишком много запросов
* `rate_limited_global` (429) — Высокая нагрузка на сервис
* `provider_keys_exhausted` (429) — Сервис временно недоступен
* `insufficient_credits` (402) — Недостаточно кредитов
* `guest_quota_exhausted` (402) — Бесплатный лимит на сегодня исчерпан
* `service_disabled` (503) — Проводятся плановые работы
* `maintenance` (503) — Проводятся плановые работы
* `guest_not_allowed` (402) — Нужна регистрация
* `service_not_in_account_terms` (403) — Сервис не подключён
* `bad_request` (400) — Некорректный запрос
* `forbidden` (403) — Доступ запрещён
* `not_found` (404) — Ничего не найдено
* `method_not_allowed` (405) — Метод HTTP не поддерживается
* `unsupported_media_type` (415) — Формат запроса не поддерживается
* `not_implemented` (501) — Режим пока не реализован

title.description: Short title for a user interface.

message.description: Detailed explanation: what happened and what to do about it. Shown to the user as is.

balance.description: Current balance in credits. Filled in on 402 so that no extra balance request is needed; null otherwise.

retryAfterSeconds.description: How many seconds to wait before retrying. Mirrors the Retry-After HTTP header. null when retrying will not help (for example, out of credits).

retryAfterText.description: The same delay as a ready-to-show phrase. Saves clients from formatting it themselves.

ApiError.description: A single response body for every rejection: validation errors, a missing key, an exhausted limit. Branch on the `error` field — it is a stable machine-readable code. `title` and `message` are meant for humans and their wording may change.

ipVersion.description: Версия IP-протокола: 4 для IPv4, 6 для IPv6.

networkAddress.description: Адрес сети (Network Address) — первый адрес в диапазоне.

broadcastAddress.description:
Широковещательный адрес (Broadcast Address) — последний адрес в диапазоне.
Для IPv6 технически не существует, но возвращаем последний адрес диапазона.

wildcardMask.description: Wildcard-маска — инверсия маски подсети (используется в ACL Cisco).

totalHosts.description:
Общее количество хостов в сети.
Для больших IPv6 сетей возвращается строка, так как BigInteger.

usableHosts.description: Количество используемых хостов (без Network и Broadcast для IPv4).

error.description: Сообщение об ошибке, если расчёт не удался.

CidrCalculationResult.description: Результат расчёта CIDR — содержит все вычисленные параметры сети.

isInRange.description: Результат проверки: true — IP находится в диапазоне.

error.description: Сообщение об ошибке, если проверка не удалась.

IpRangeCheckResult.description: Результат проверки принадлежности IP-адреса к CIDR-диапазону.

originalCidr.description: Исходный CIDR, который разбивается на подсети.

isTruncated.description: Флаг, указывающий что результат был ограничен.

error.description: Сообщение об ошибке, если расчёт не удался.

inputs.description:
Список входных IP-адресов и/или CIDR для агрегации.
Поддерживаемые разделители: новая строка, запятая, точка с запятой, пробел.

error.description: Сообщение об ошибке, если расчёт не удался.

warnings.description: Список предупреждений (например, если некоторые входные значения не распознаны).

ApiKeyBearer.description:
The API key goes into the `Authorization: Bearer ak_…` header.

Keys are created in your account: https://atlorium.com/Account/Manage/ApiKeys

To try it without registration and without being charged, use the demo key
`ak_sandbox_demo_mockdata_v1` — it returns mock data and marks the response with
the `X-Atlorium-Sandbox: true` header.
